senses.gloss: (cmp. כְּרוּב), Ithpe. אִיכְּרַף to become round (of the nipple of the breast), to develop.
units: Nidd. 48ᵇ top (ref. to Ez. XXIII, 21) אִיכָּרְפוּ דדיך … אישתדו וכ׳ thy breasts began to develop, yet thou didst not repent, thy breasts were fully developped, yet &c.; [other interpret. in Rashi: איכ׳ to be swollen, אישת׳ to dry up; Ar.: איכרפית, v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v.].
